Branch: mick/ltx23-per-sample-adaln (on main 02b983603d), commit 89d01fddaf

## Motivation

LTX-2.3 two-stage passes per-token timesteps (`[B, T]`) even when there is no denoise mask, so every token carries the same sigma. The DiT then runs its AdaLN MLPs on B*T rows. For the two batched guidance passes per CFG rank that builds a `[2, 1536, 9 * 4096]` table, 226 MB per forward. `ltx2_ada_values9` re-reads it in every block (37 us per block per modality), and every modulation and gate becomes a per-token tensor.

## Modifications

`ltx_2/denoising.py`: `_ltx23_token_timesteps` returns one row per sample (`[B, 1]`) under `quality="lossless"`, and the per-token `[B, T]` expansion under `exact`. A denoise mask keeps its per-token path. The DiT already broadcasts `[B, 1]` rows, as it does for LTX-2.

The values are identical. The AdaLN GEMMs run at M = B instead of M = B*T, and the broadcast modulations take the fused kernels, so only rounding moves.

## Tests

`test_ltx23_per_sample_adaln.py`: the lossless rows are `[B, 1]` and expand to the exact rows. A 2-block LTX-2.3-shaped model (prompt AdaLN, gated attention) gives the same outputs within bf16 rounding for per-sample and per-token rows.

## Accuracy Tests

4xB300 (2 GPUs), LTX-2.3 two-stage 768x512x121, 30 steps, official guider: PSNR against main 18.0 / 19.8 / 19.7 / 18.5 dB.

Reference band for a rounding-only change on this workload: the same server with `quality="exact"` against the default `lossless` (which already mounts other rounding-moving fusions) gives LTX-2 PSNR 17.0 / 20.6 / 23.1 / 20.8 dB and LTX-2.3 18.1 / 19.3 / 17.6 / 20.4 dB over the same four prompts. The 40-step CFG trajectory amplifies any rounding difference to that level, so the e2e number shows only that the change stays inside the band every rounding change lands in.

CI: only `ltx_2.3_two_stage_t2v_2gpus` takes this path (threshold PSNR 16 dB, SSIM 0.45). The HQ pipeline (raw-sigma timesteps), the one-stage legacy path and TI2V (denoise mask) keep per-token rows.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same setup. `ltx2_ada_values9` drops from 36.8 us to 4.2 us per call. Client median: 4.27 s before, 4.07 s with this PR alone. With the FA4 routing PR, stage 1 goes from 3.149 s to 2.918 s (105.0 to 97.2 ms per step).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

             self._ltx2_coords_cache.popitem(last=False)
         return coords
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _ltx23_token_timesteps(
+        timestep: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int, batch: Req
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Per-token LTX-2.3 timesteps ``[B, num_tokens]``, or ``[B, 1]`` under lossless.
+
+        Without a denoise mask every token carries the step's sigma, so the DiT can
+        build one AdaLN row per sample and broadcast it instead of one per token.
+        """
+        timestep = timestep.view(-1, 1)
+        if quality_allows(batch.quality, "lossless"):
+            return timestep
+        return timestep.expand(-1, num_tokens)
+

+import unittest
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+import sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.ltx_2 as ltx_2
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.ltx_2 import LTX2ArchConfig, LTX2Config
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
+    model_parallel_is_initialized,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention import layer
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.sdpa import SDPABackend
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.managers.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.ltx_2.denoising import (
+    LTX2DenoisingStage,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.test.single_test_file.component_accuracy.utils import (
+    ensure_distributed_env_defaults,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+class TestLTX23PerSampleAdaLN(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_lossless_builds_one_row_per_sample(self):
+        timestep = torch.tensor([700.0, 700.0])
+        rows = LTX2DenoisingStage._ltx23_token_timesteps(
+            timestep, 6, SimpleNamespace(quality="lossless")
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(rows.shape), (2, 1))
+        tokens = LTX2DenoisingStage._ltx23_token_timesteps(
+            timestep, 6, SimpleNamespace(quality="exact")
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(tokens.shape), (2, 6))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(tokens, rows.expand(2, 6)))
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def test_one_row_per_sample_matches_per_token_rows(self):
+        if not model_parallel_is_initialized():
+            ensure_distributed_env_defaults()
+            maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(tp_size=1, sp_size=1)
+        with ExitStack() as stack:
+            for name, value in (
+                ("get_attn_backend", SDPABackend),
+                ("get_compute_dtype", torch.bfloat16),
+                ("_resolve_sp_attention_mode", ("ulysses", False)),
+                ("_maybe_install_backend_autotune", None),
+            ):
+                stack.enter_context(patch.object(layer, name, return_value=value))
+            stack.enter_context(set_forward_context(0, None))
+            torch.manual_seed(0)
+            arch = LTX2ArchConfig(
+                num_layers=2,
+                num_attention_heads=2,
+                attention_head_dim=32,
+                in_channels=16,
+                out_channels=16,
+                cross_attention_dim=64,
+                caption_channels=64,
+                audio_num_attention_heads=2,
+                audio_attention_head_dim=16,
+                audio_in_channels=16,
+                audio_out_channels=16,
+                audio_cross_attention_dim=32,
+                cross_attention_adaln=True,
+                apply_gated_attention=True,
+            )
+            arch.ltx_variant = "ltx_2_3"
+            model = ltx_2.LTX2VideoTransformer3DModel(
+                LTX2Config(arch_config=arch), hf_config={}
+            ).to(torch.bfloat16)
+            for parameter in model.parameters():
+                parameter.normal_(std=0.05)
+            sigma = torch.tensor([0.6, 0.6])
+            kwargs = dict(
+                hidden_states=torch.randn(2, 32, 16, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+                audio_hidden_states=torch.randn(2, 5, 16, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+                encoder_hidden_states=torch.randn(2, 6, 64, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+                audio_encoder_hidden_states=torch.randn(2, 6, 64, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+                prompt_timestep=sigma * 1000,
+                audio_prompt_timestep=sigma * 1000,
+                num_frames=2,
+                height=4,
+                width=4,
+                audio_num_frames=5,
+                return_latents=False,
+            )
+            per_token = model(
+                **kwargs,
+                timestep=(sigma * 1000).view(2, 1).expand(2, 32),
+                audio_timestep=(sigma * 1000).view(2, 1).expand(2, 5),
+            )
+            per_sample = model(
+                **kwargs,
+                timestep=(sigma * 1000).view(2, 1),
+                audio_timestep=(sigma * 1000).view(2, 1),
+            )
+            for a, e in zip(per_sample, per_token, strict=True):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(a, e, rtol=0, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
